reference_adapter.policy: execute the unchanged model_init once to establish all source dependencies, clear the loaded model InitFcn only in memory, inject each private input set into the original top-level source variables, and close without saving

groups.G: load, update, compile, all five simulations, complete finite evidence, correct four-channel streaming and valid contracts, and a connected covariance-to-weight-to-output path
groups.A: desired-signal preservation, distortionless steering response, and demodulated QPSK quality
groups.Q: interferer suppression, output noise gain, fixed-point agreement, bounded values, and absence of saturation
groups.M: measured-input covariance, diagonal loading, matrix-solve residual, normalization identity, and weights causally driving the beamformed output
groups.R: 100 percent worst-case critical performance over all five required scenarios
groups.D: first-valid latency, covariance/weight update cadence, and convergence or stability across successive adaptation windows

aggregation.within_group: weighted arithmetic mean of dedicated normalized indicators

shortcut_minimum: single-channel passthrough or a non-adaptive phase-shift beamformer
hard-coded nominal weights or steering angle
replayed desired QPSK or precomputed reference output
steering vector, diagonal loading, interference, noise, or InputValid ignored
one scalar duplicated into four apparent weights
covariance formed from a desired reference rather than measured four-channel samples
matrix solve or adaptive weights disconnected from the final beam output
floating-point implementation presented as a fixed-point HDL-compatible path
fabricated always-valid handshakes without real adaptation latency
